paragraphs: R' Yehudah bar Rabbi, or Beribbi.
See the entry Yehudah, son of R' Chiyya, and the entry R' Yudan Beribbi.[^1]

notes.text: The heading’s bar Rabbi has full רבי and stays Rabbi; Beribbi is retained as the supplied alternative without interpreting it as an admitted rank or father. Earlier machine/catalog בריב differs from supplied בריבי. Both targets are preserved: bare Yehudah son of R' Chiyya and R' Yudan Beribbi. The other three title components are abbreviated and remain R', without importing catalog רבי or merging targets.
